The Wingback Horizontal Kids Bed combines horizontal channels with softly curved wingback sides that frame the headboard, fully upholstered and handmade to order in Dewsbury.

Key features

  • Horizontal channel headboard with curved wingback sides
  • Fully upholstered enclosed side panels and matching footboard
  • Rounded design with no sharp edges
  • Solid, sturdy wood frame
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Comes with a wooden slatted base

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £299.00; Small Double (4FT) £299.00; Kids Single (2.6FT) £299.00. One price applies to all three sizes. Not sure which size to pick? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a solid, sturdy wood frame that is fully upholstered with rounded edges. Available in colours including Cream, Silver, Grey, Steel, Beige, Red, Green, White, Black, Blue, Pink and Brown, in fabrics such as Plush Velvet and Chenille. Bespoke requests are welcome, and free fabric swatches are available.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Firm Memory Foam Mattress or the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. You can return it free within 14 days if unused and unassembled in its original packaging (we collect it), and if an item arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

What do the wings add?

The wings frame the headboard and add extra cosiness compared with the Horizontal Channel Kids Bed.

What sizes does the Wingback Horizontal Kids Bed come in?

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT) and Kids Single (2.6FT).

Does the bed have sharp edges?

No. It is fully upholstered with enclosed side panels and a rounded design, with no sharp edges.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery across Great Britain is free and usually takes 3-5 working days, as each bed is handmade to order.

What warranty does it have?

Every Eagle Bed comes with a 5-year warranty.

The Duchess Ottoman Bed pairs crushed velvet with a tall winged headboard, deep-buttoned by hand and finished with crystal-effect buttons, on a gas lift ottoman base with storage under the whole mattress.

Key features

  • Tall winged headboard with deep buttoning
  • Crystal-effect diamante buttons (fabric-covered buttons also available)
  • Gas-lift ottoman base with storage under the whole mattress
  • Fully upholstered to the floor, no exposed legs

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £324.99; Small Double (4FT) £357.99; Double (4FT6) £370.99; King (5FT) £402.99; Super King (6FT) £467.99. Need a different size or headboard height? Ask us about a bespoke version. Not sure which size to pick? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and fully upholstered by hand in our West Yorkshire workshop, with no exposed legs. Crushed velvet with crystal-effect buttons, or fabric-covered buttons if you prefer. Free fabric swatches are available so you can see the colour in your own light before you order.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Firm Memory Foam Mattress or the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. You can return it free within 14 days if unused and unassembled in its original packaging (we collect it), and if an item arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

How does the storage work?

The base lifts on gas lifts, giving access to storage under the whole mattress. Leave clear height above the bed.

Are the buttons real crystal?

They are crystal-effect diamante buttons; fabric-covered buttons are also available.

What sizes does the Duchess Ottoman Bed come in?

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT).

Can I see the fabric first?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available.

How long does delivery take?

Free across Great Britain, usually 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90.

How do I care for it?

Vacuum gently with a soft brush attachment and blot spills straight away with a clean, damp cloth.
